name: Jiangsu Soho High Hope Group Corporation Class A
summary: Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation is a diversified conglomerate operating across various sectors, both domestically in China and on an international scale. Its comprehensive business activities span trade, real estate development, strategic investment, logistics solutions, manufacturing, and general services. The company operates an integrated cold-chain logistics network, which seamlessly combines warehousing, transportation, processing, display, and commercial trading functions. It also manages a significant healthcare supply chain. Furthermore, the group specializes in the import and export of a wide array of goods, such as textiles and apparel, pulp and paper products, wood panels, as well as marine vessels and electromechanical equipment. Beyond its core trade and logistics, Jiangsu High Hope actively participates in industrial investments, supply chain financing, and financial asset management. Its real estate division is responsible for developing diverse property ventures, including residential villas, condominiums, and various commercial projects. The company markets its diverse portfolio of products and services through a range of recognized brands, including High Hope, SKYRUN, Forecast Spring, Gold Plum, JSTEX, Ashare, JSLTOYS, Friendly, Swallow Brand, Tiger, and Giraffe. Established in 1996, Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation is headquartered in Nanjing, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Suhui Asset Management Co. Ltd.
